rows.abstract: Prescribes the following types of indemnity got said victims: (1) In case of death, a one-time lump sum payment of P20,000 for each victim to be paid to his heirs; (2)  In case of injury, a medical treatment assistance of P5,000 for less serious physical injury and P10,000 for serious physical injuries. rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THE REPRESENTATION OF EXPORTERS IN THE GOVERNING BOARD OF THE SUGAR REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE, SECTION 4 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 18, ENTITLED 'CREATING A SUGAR REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION'
rows.abstract: Despite having as its objective the development of the sugar industry for export, the sugar exporters are not specifically represented in the policy-making body of the Sugar Regulatory Board.  The Executive Order merely provides that the two privatesector representatives represent the millers and the planters. With the representation of the exporters in the Governing Board of the SRA, it will be assured that the policies and programs for the sugar industry will take into consideration the actual experiences of exporting.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REPRESENTATION OF THE EXPORTERS IN THE GOVERNING BOARD OF THE PHILIPPINE COCONUT AUTHORITY, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 232, SECTION 4, ENTITLED 'CREATING A PHILIPPINE COCONUT ANUTHORITY,' AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: To address the need to develop the coconut industry to achieve its full revenue-generat ing potential, it should be geared towards being able to compete globally. Since the exporters would have the experience and the expertise to address the problems in this aspect, the coconut industry will benefit much if the exporters will have a hand in steering its policies and programs. Thus, exporters' representation in the PCA Governing Board is proposed.

rows.abstract: With such a demanding role, it is surprising that the sector most affected by the maritime, industry, the exporters, is not represented in the MARINA Board.  The export sector is where our country relies on for economic growth. Ironically, they arenot represented in the policy-making body that significantly affect out country's overseas trade. Therefore, amending Presidential Decree 474, to include a representative of the export sector to the MARINA Board is sought through this measure.
